id: title:Gilbert09:surface a clear error for a non ascii api key

review.posthog_relevance: Adds credential validation and user-friendly error handling for warehouse import, preventing Unicode encoding failures in HTTP headers.
review.reason: P1.F1.H1 adds a check to detect non-ASCII characters in the Attio API key before the HTTP request, returning False and a user-friendly error message instead of attempting the request. P1.F2.H1 adds a unit test to verify this behavior. This prevents a UnicodeEncodeError from propagating to the user, which could result in confusing error messages or potential information disclosure.
review.uncertainty: The benefit is limited to preventing a specific encoding error and improving the user experience for warehouse import; no broader systemic impact or critical path dependency is demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 adds a credential validation check and an error message. P1.F2.H1 adds a unit test. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a check before the HTTP request to detect non-ASCII characters in the Attio API key. If detected, it returns False and a user-friendly error message instead of attempting the request.
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents a UnicodeEncodeError from propagating to the user when an API key cannot be encoded into the HTTP Authorization header, which is required for the requests library. This could prevent confusing error messages or potential information disclosure about the encoding failure.

observations.behavior: Adds a unit test to verify that a non-ASCII API key returns False and a message containing 'Retype it by hand', while excluding the raw encoding error details.
observations.posthog_connection: This test validates the implementation of the credential check, ensuring users receive a helpful message rather than a technical encoding error. This supports the reliability and user experience of the warehouse import feature.
